name: Launch Cape pad and rocket support composition

approval.note: W0 design proposal only; not drawn, gated, approved or available for placement.

variants.note: The pad/gantry composition around the separately owned rocket art.

story.lore: Make the exposed headland’s rocket launch site readable and keep the service approach separate from the launch aperture.

todo: Purpose: Make the exposed headland’s rocket launch site readable and keep the service approach separate from the launch aperture.

Visual brief: Circular pad inset into a square engineered apron, deep exhaust trench toward the sea, visible support gantry and service tower; rocket equipment reads as three-dimensional machinery with a strong grounded base.
Implement after review: Claude selects the design, draws it, supplies exact anchors/collision and passes the library gate; no concept may ship.
Geometry: proposed authoring envelope 28x20 cells; one cell is 8 world px / 24 art px. This is not an asserted solid footprint; collision, foot and overhang await the drawing.
Scale: site-specific composition envelope; rocket remains Claude D’s asset/ownership, not a generic prop generated by W0.
Rule proposal: exhaust trench, vehicle/service access and passenger approach have disjoint explicit safety/clearance geometry; this adds no timing or failure mechanic.
Uniqueness: one launch pad facing the open sea; generic concrete, pipes and railings may repeat.
